ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: A transition-state structure is visible in the figure, and the main chain can be written as R-C(=O)-NH-NH-SO2Ar, with B: beside it and several curved arrows; each of the two nitrogens is drawn with one H. Reasoning: According to the problem statement, exclude all bonds involving hydrogen, and do not count curved arrows or proton-transfer schematics as bonds. The non-hydrogen bond list is: R-C, C=O, C-N, N-N, N-S, S=O, S=O, S-Ar, a total of 8. Ar represents an aromatic ring, and the aromatic ring itself has 6 intra-ring bonds. Total = 8 + 6 = 14.

Count these as 8. Add the 6 aromatic ring bonds represented by Ar. Do not count the two N-H bonds or any curved-arrow/proton-transfer depiction. Total = 8 + 6 = 14.

method.method_draft: Partition the pictured structure into modules after visually identifying R-C(=O)-NH-NH-SO2Ar. Count non-H bonds by module: acyl part R-C(=O)-N = 3 bonds; hydrazide N-N = 1 bond; N-S connection = 1 bond; sulfonyl external bonds S=O, S=O, S-Ar = 3 bonds; aryl ring represented by Ar = 6 bonds. Exclude N-H and any B/H arrow interaction. Sum 3 + 1 + 1 + 3 + 6 = 14.
